decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component dosing and pumping expertise, so it can interpret field results and refine the unit in-house, although the lack of website evidence for 2020 to 2021 adds some uncertainty.
It rests on the same core plural-component knowledge, but its overlap with Product A and the missing evidence since 2019 make consolidation into one injection line more likely than for A.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory closely tied to the firm's pumps and existing customers, so field feedback is easy to absorb and the product is cheap to sustain.

The air-assisted airless line extends the firm's established spray technology across several models for industrial coaters, fitting its knowledge base well despite the C withdrawal showing gun lines can be pruned.

The data logger draws on digital and electronic knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, which makes it harder to assimilate, but it supports service and documentation trends in coating, so the firm keeps it while it builds competence.
